examQuestions.prompt: A: Is Pak Harun in the office? B: No, he ___ to the bank. He'll be back in an hour.
examQuestions.explanation: Pak Harun pergi dan belum kembali → **has gone**. *Has been* berarti sudah pergi dan sudah kembali, jadi tidak cocok.

examQuestions.prompt: Complete the dialogue with already or yet.
examQuestions.text: A: Have you booked the hotel ___? B: Yes, I've ___ done it. I booked it this morning.
examQuestions.explanation: **Yet** dipakai di akhir pertanyaan present perfect; **already** di tengah kalimat positive untuk sesuatu yang terjadi lebih cepat dari dugaan.

examQuestions.prompt: Find the mistake in the sentence.
segments: When I got to the station,
examQuestions.explanation: Kereta berangkat **sebelum** saya tiba, jadi pakai past perfect: *the train had already left*.

examQuestions.prompt: Please turn off the lights before you ___ the office tonight.
examQuestions.explanation: Setelah time conjunction seperti **before / when / as soon as**, kita memakai present simple untuk masa depan: *before you leave*.

examQuestions.prompt: Rewrite the sentence using unless.
examQuestions.sentence: If you don't water these plants, they'll die.
answers: These plants will die unless you water them.
These plants'll die unless you water them.
These plants will die unless you water them regularly.
examQuestions.explanation: **Unless** = *if ... not*. Jadi *If you don't water them* → *unless you water them* (tanpa not).

examQuestions.prompt: I'm tired of taking two buses to work. I wish I ___ a car.
examQuestions.explanation: Keinginan tentang masa sekarang → **I wish + past simple**: *I wish I had a car.*

examQuestions.prompt: Choose the correct verb form for each gap.
examQuestions.text: If it ___ tomorrow, we'll cancel the picnic. But if I ___ a million dollars, I'd buy a house by the sea.
examQuestions.explanation: Kalimat pertama adalah kemungkinan nyata (*we'll*) → first conditional: **rains**. Kalimat kedua imajiner (*I'd*) → second conditional: **had**.

examQuestions.prompt: Which sentences mean that parking here is NOT allowed? Choose all correct answers.
options: You don't have to park here.
You aren't allowed to park here.
examQuestions.explanation: **Mustn't, aren't allowed to, can't** = larangan. *Don't have to* dan *needn't* hanya berarti tidak perlu.

examQuestions.prompt: Complete the sentences with the passive form of the verbs in brackets.
examQuestions.text: Our school ___ (build) in 1965. Today, it ___ (paint) every five years.
examQuestions.explanation: Fakta sejarah → past simple passive: **was built**. Kebiasaan sekarang → present simple passive: **is painted**.

examQuestions.prompt: Rewrite the sentence in the passive.
examQuestions.sentence: Thousands of tourists visit the old castle every year.
answers: The old castle is visited by thousands of tourists every year.
The old castle is visited every year by thousands of tourists.
examQuestions.explanation: Present simple passive: **is + V3**, dan pelakunya penting (ribuan turis) → *by thousands of tourists*.

examQuestions.prompt: That's the man ___ car was stolen last night.
examQuestions.explanation: **Whose** menunjukkan kepemilikan: mobil milik pria itu → *the man whose car was stolen*.

examQuestions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
examQuestions.explanation: Relative clause **where we had lunch** menjelaskan *the restaurant*, lalu kalimat utama berlanjut: *was very expensive*.

examQuestions.prompt: A week later, you report what Siti said. Use tense backshift and change the time word.
examQuestions.sentence: "I'm working from home today," Siti said.
answers: Siti said she was working from home that day.
Siti said that she was working from home that day.
examQuestions.explanation: Present continuous → past continuous (**was working**), *I* → *she*, dan *today* → **that day** karena dilaporkan seminggu kemudian.

examQuestions.prompt: Raka ___ that he was moving to Kotabaru.
examQuestions.explanation: **Say + that** (tanpa orang). *Tell* harus diikuti orang: *told me that ...*

examQuestions.prompt: Report the question. Use tense backshift.
examQuestions.context: "Where do you live?" the receptionist asked me.
examQuestions.text: The receptionist asked me where I ___.
examQuestions.explanation: Reported question memakai susunan pernyataan (tanpa *do*) dan backshift: *do you live* → **I lived**.

examQuestions.prompt: Choose the correct form for each gap.
examQuestions.text: I'm thinking of ___ to drive, and my father has promised ___ me.
examQuestions.explanation: Setelah preposition (*of*) → V-ing: **learning**. **Promise + to + V1** → *to teach*.

examQuestions.prompt: Find the mistake in the sentence.
examQuestions.explanation: **Be used to + V-ing**: *is used to walking*. To di sini adalah preposition.

examQuestions.prompt: Match each word with its definition.

pairs.right: a story that people talk about, which may not be true
the time by which you must finish something
one of the foods used to make a dish
a famous building that is easy to recognise
money that you owe to someone

examQuestions.explanation: **Rumour** = desas-desus, **deadline** = tenggat, **ingredient** = bahan masakan, **landmark** = tengara, **debt** = utang.

examQuestions.prompt: Translate into English.
examQuestions.explanation: *Dibangun* (fakta di masa lalu) → past simple passive **was built**.

examQuestions.prompt: Choose the best reply.

dialogue.speaker: Fani
dialogue.text: Look, Sinta is wearing a wedding ring!

dialogue.speaker: Fani
dialogue.text: I didn't know that. I'll congratulate her.

options: She must to be married now.
examQuestions.explanation: Cincin kawin adalah bukti kuat → deduction **must be**. *Can't* berlawanan dengan bukti, *must to* salah bentuk, dan *mustn't* adalah larangan.

placementQuestions.explanation: Situasi dari masa lalu sampai sekarang dengan *How long* → present perfect: **have you lived**.

placementQuestions.prompt: When I arrived at the party, most of the guests ___ home.
placementQuestions.explanation: Para tamu pulang **sebelum** saya tiba → past perfect **had gone**.

placementQuestions.prompt: If she ___ the answer, she would tell us.
placementQuestions.explanation: Second conditional (*would tell*) → if-clause memakai past simple: **knew**.

placementQuestions.prompt: You ___ smoke in the hospital. It's against the rules.

placementQuestions.explanation: Fakta umum tentang proses → present simple passive: **is made**.

placementQuestions.prompt: I've lost the book ___ you lent me.
placementQuestions.explanation: Untuk benda kita memakai **that/which**. *Who* untuk orang, *where* untuk tempat, *whose* untuk kepemilikan.

placementQuestions.prompt: "I saw the film last week," said Doni. → Doni told me he ___ the film the week before.
placementQuestions.explanation: Dalam reported speech, past simple (*saw*) mundur menjadi past perfect: **had seen**.

placementQuestions.prompt: Complete the sentence with the correct form of the verb in brackets.
placementQuestions.text: It was raining, so we decided ___ (stay) at home.

placementQuestions.prompt: We'll start the meeting when everyone ___.
placementQuestions.explanation: Setelah *when* untuk masa depan, pakai present simple: **arrives**.

placementQuestions.prompt: "The museum is very crowded at weekends, so I prefer to go on weekdays." What does 'crowded' mean?
placementQuestions.explanation: **Crowded** = penuh orang / ramai. Karena itu pembicara memilih datang pada hari kerja.

placementQuestions.prompt: When I was a child, I ___ play football in the street every afternoon.
placementQuestions.explanation: Kebiasaan di masa lalu yang sudah berubah → **used to + V1**.

placementQuestions.prompt: Complete the sentence with the correct form of the verb in brackets.
placementQuestions.text: If it ___ (rain) tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
placementQuestions.explanation: First conditional: **If + present simple**, will + V1. Jangan pakai *will* di if-clause.
